FULL PAYMENT AGREEMENT 
 
 
 
 This FULL PAYMENT AGREEMENT (the “Agreement”) is made at Lahore on this day of 6 th day of August, 2019 (the “ Effective Date ”) by and between 
 
 
 
 MR. KHWAJA SAADIQ HUSAIN s/o Khwaja Muhammad Husain bearing CNIC No. 35201-1288433-3 (hereinafter referred to as the “ Seller ” which expression shall, where the context so permits, include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) of the ONE PART ; 
 
 AND 
 
 ZAMEEN PLATINUM (PRIVATE) LIMITED , having its registered office at 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, through its authorized representative, namely Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan (hereinafter referred as the “ Buyer ” which expression shall, where the context so permits, include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART . 
 
 [The Seller and Buyer are hereinafter also individually referred to as “ Party ” and collectively referred to as the “Parties” ]. 
 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 
 The Seller is the absolute and lawful owner in possession of the property measuring 7 (seven) kanals and 42 (forty-two) square feet, located at Scheme no. 5, Plot no. 49, Gulberg V, Lahore (hereinafter referred to as the “ Property ” as more fully described in Schedule A ); which schedule should be read as the integral part of this Agreement. 
 
 The Seller and the Buyer entered into a n agreement to sell 30 th May, 2019 (the “ Agreement to Sell ”) in respect of the sale of the Property for total sale consider ation of an aggregate amount of Rs . 388,500,000 (Rupees three hundred and eighty-eight million and five hundred thousand) , (the “ Sale Consideration ”) . Out of the Sale Consideration, the Buyer has paid an paid an amount of Rs . 20,000,000 (Rupees twenty million) to the Seller as an advance or Biana , as part-payment towards the Sale Consideration for the purchase of the Property (the “ Biana ”) vide pay order No.GLBPOO1426, dated 30 th May, 2019, drawn on JS Bank Limit ed, Gulberg Branch, Lahore-9123 in favor of the Seller . 
 
 T he Parties agreed that payment of the balance amount of the Sale Consideration after payment of Biana , that is an amount of Rs . 368,500,000 (Rupees three hundred and sixty-eight million and five hundred thousand) (the “ Balance Consideration ”) , shall be subject to execution of sale deed and transfer/conveyance of Property to the Buyer free from all encumbrances, mortgages charges, cesses, etc. (the “ Sale Deed ”), by the Seller for the sale and transfer of the Property in favour of the Buyer. 
 
 T he Parties are desirous of entering into this Agreement on the terms and conditions stated therein. 
 
 
 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , in consideration of the mutual covenants and terms hereinafter set below it is hereby agreed as follows: 
 
 T he Seller has executed the Sale Deed on 17 th June, 2019 bearing Document no.1429, Book no.1, Volume no.868, dated 29.6.2019 , in respect of the Property, in favour of the Buyer and the Seller has sold , convey ed , assign ed , transferred and assure d unto the Buyer, alo ng with peaceful possession, his full, absolute and unencumbered rights, title and interests in the Property on the terms and conditions stated herein. 
 
 T he Buyer hereby pays the entire Balance Consideration to the Seller through Pay Order bearing No. _______ dated ______ in favour of K hwaja S aadiq H usain , which is acknowledged by the Seller . The Seller further acknowledge s that he do es not ha ve any claim in respect of the Sale Consideration against the Buyer. 
 
 The Parties agree that in the event the P roperty is not free from encumbrances, such as dispute related to its title, lien, charge, benefit or any interest whatsoever, whether existing or created or purporting to exist or be created, and whether present, future or contingent, including those in the nature of sale, agreement to sell, pledge, hypothecation, mortgage, charge (whether fixed or floating), adverse possession, or any other rights or encumbrances generally or any other adverse claim of any kind whatsoever on the Property , preventing the Buyer from enjoying the Property, in whole or any part thereof, the Seller shall be jointly and severally liable for any loss/damage to the Buyer . Said loss/damage shall at a minimum include: 
 
 loss of value due to defect of title, which loss shall be equivalent to the amount paid by the Buyer to the Seller as Sale Consideration or the market value of the Property with no defect in title as determined by the Buyer , whichever is higher ; 
 
 the cost incurred by the Buyer on the development of the Property; and 
 
 any cost/expense incurred by the Buyer in undertaking the acquisition of the Property. 
 
 IN WITNESS, WHEREOF both the Parties have signed this Agreement on the day, month &amp; year as first above written.
